_meta.effect_size_direction: effect_size is mean(config_b - config_a). Positive means config_b performs better or is less variable, depending on the section.
_meta.p_explanation: p is the two-sided permutation-test p-value under the null hypothesis of no real difference.
_meta.one_minus_p_percent_explanation: one_minus_p_percent is (1 - p) * 100. It is a descriptive transformation of p.
_meta.performance_stats_explanation: performance_stats uses the mean of raw_data over the five runs.
_meta.stability_stats_explanation: stability_stats uses per-instance SD or MAD computed from the five raw_data values.
_meta.sd_explanation: SD is the per-instance standard deviation across the five runs.
_meta.mad_explanation: MAD is the per-instance mean absolute deviation from the five-run mean.
_meta.3_levels_explanation: 3_levels pools function, module, and file samples together.
